column1: # The server names that tell a messenger's own connections from its proxy's (ADR 0052). A name matches a row when it is
# the row's name or ends in "." and it. Columns: family, role, name, where it is read, checked. Roles:
#   own     the maker's own service: a connection to it is the app going directly, never through its proxy
#   front   a name the app sends to reach its own service through another company's network (Signal's own
#   other   a third party the app reaches itself (payments, a captcha, debug logs, MobileCoin): not a proxy, nor
#           what the app reaches within ten minutes after (its web view's pages: a card issuer's 3-D Secure)
